Pamela Aaralyn is a world renowned trance channel, mystic and spiritual teacher. Pamela is a galactic historian , remote viewer and can bi-locate where she interacts with “Humans from the Future” across  various points in time where she has met various personalities including scientists, physicists, farmers, economists, historians, yoga teachers, future presidents. She gains insight into future Earth in various timelines with knowledge of how we can shape Earth’s future together.

From age of 5, Pamela has channeled and worked with Angels, Ascended Masters, Galactic Beings and Adepts. Pamela works closely with Christ Conscious beings and her spirit guide team, “The Council of 9”. With over four decades of dedicated training alongside these spirit guides, she is grounded with commitment and a strong set of ethics. Pamela works with sound as a shaman and has produced 2 sacred music albums. Check out her upcoming Gaia TV 2025 debut and her work with Next Level Soul TV.
